content: {"summary":"On 15 Feb 2025 payments fell back to static rules while fraud‑scorer‑01 memory rose without restarts; the root was feature‑cache growth causing slowdown.","likely_cause":"Feature‑cache growth in fraud‑scorer‑01 increased memory usage and slowed the scorer, causing payments‑api to fall back to static rules.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Payments‑api used static rules instead of the model when the scorer was slow","evidence_ids":["INC-0013#0"],"quote":"payments-api, scoring with static rules instead of the model"},{"text":"Fraud‑scorer‑01 memory working set was rising steadily with no pod restarts","evidence_ids":["log:431","INC-0013#1"],"quote":"WARN fraud-scorer-01.prod.internal memory watch: working_set_mib=2452 limit_mib=3072"},{"text":"The memory increase was driven by rapid growth of the scorer's feature cache","evidence_ids":["INC-0013#2"],"quote":"fastest-growing allocation site was in the feature cache"},{"text":"Redis‑features‑01 latency was abnormally high, contributing to scorer slowdown","evidence_ids":["INC-0013#1"],"quote":"redis-cli --latency against redis-features-01 returned figures far above its normal range"}],"next_checks":["Check Grafana \"Container memory (working set)\" for fraud‑scorer‑01 trends","Inspect the feature‑cache size via the tracemalloc endpoint","Review FRD‑W118 log occurrences on fraud‑scorer‑01","Run redis‑features‑01 latency checks (e.g., redis-cli --latency)","Consult RB‑005 for memory‑shape analysis and RB‑006 for cache‑related runbooks"]}
